+last_updated: 2026-03-11
+status: draft

+
+# State Persistence
+
+## Overview
+
+Canvas state lives in-memory in a Zustand store (`useCanvasStore`) with no persist middleware. The state is saved to PostgreSQL via the `CanvasDraft` Prisma model through a debounced auto-save mechanism that triggers after each history change. If the browser tab is closed before the auto-save fires, unsaved changes are lost.
+
+## Component Inventory
+
+| Component              | File                                 | Responsibility                                           |
+| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------- |
+| `useCanvasStore`       | `store/canvas-store.ts`              | Zustand store: canvas objects, history, page size        |
+| `useSaveCanvas`        | `hooks/use-canvas-save.ts`           | Auto-save hook with debounce, thumbnail upload           |
+| `GazaiCanvas`          | `components/canvas/gazai-canvas.tsx` | Wires `debouncedSave` to history changes via `useEffect` |
+| `createCanvasDraft`    | `actions/canvas/canvas.ts`           | Server action: create a new draft                        |
+| `updateCanvasDraft`    | `actions/canvas/canvas.ts`           | Server action: update an existing draft                  |
+| `saveCanvasDraft`      | `actions/canvas/canvas.ts`           | Server action: lightweight save (data only)              |
+| `deleteCanvasDraft`    | `actions/canvas/canvas.ts`           | Server action: soft-delete a draft                       |
+| `duplicateCanvasDraft` | `actions/canvas/canvas.ts`           | Server action: duplicate with new IDs                    |
+| `getCanvasDraftById`   | `data/canvas-draft.ts`               | Data layer: fetch a single draft by ID                   |
+| `getCanvasDrafts`      | `data/canvas-draft.ts`               | Data layer: paginated draft listing                      |
+
+## Data Models
+
+### Client-Side State (Zustand)
+
+```typescript
+// store/canvas-store.ts
+export type HistoryEntry = {
+  action: HistoryAction;
+  canvasObjects: CanvasObject[];
+  pageSize?: { width: number; height: number };
+  timestamp: number;
+};
+```
+
+| Field               | Type              | Persisted | Description                                      |
+| ------------------- | ----------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------- |
+| `id`                | `string`          | Yes       | Draft ID (matches `CanvasDraft.id`)              |
+| `name`              | `string`          | Yes       | Draft name                                       |
+| `canvasObjects`     | `CanvasObject[]`  | Yes       | Committed canvas objects (the "saved" state)     |
+| `tempCanvasObjects` | `CanvasObject[]   | null`     | No                                               | Working copy during in-progress edits |
+| `pageSize`          | `{width, height}` | Yes       | Canvas dimensions                                |
+| `history`           | `HistoryEntry[]`  | No        | Undo/redo stack (session-only, max 50 entries)   |
+| `historyIndex`      | `number`          | No        | Current position in the history stack            |
+| `stage`             | `Konva.Stage`     | No        | Konva stage reference                            |
+| `lastSavedAt`       | `number           | null`     | No                                               | Timestamp of last successful save     |
+| `isSaving`          | `boolean`         | No        | True while a save is in progress                 |
+| `isLoaded`          | `boolean`         | No        | True after `loadFromCanvasDraft` completes       |
+| `isReadOnly`        | `boolean`         | No        | True when admin is viewing another user's canvas |
+| `usedFonts`         | `string[]`        | No        | Font families loaded for the current session     |
+
+### Server-Side Model (CanvasDraft)
+
+```prisma
+// prisma/schema.prisma
+model CanvasDraft {
+  id               String    @id @default(cuid())
+  userId           String
+  initialized      Boolean   @default(false)
+  name             String    @default("Untitled")
+  pageWidth        Int       @default(800)
+  pageHeight       Int       @default(10000)
+  data             Json
+  thumbnailImageId String?
+  createdAt        DateTime  @default(now())
+  updatedAt        DateTime  @default(now()) @updatedAt
+  deletedAt        DateTime?
+  deletedBy        String?
+  isSample         Boolean   @default(false)
+  // ... relations omitted
+}
+```
+
+| Field              | Type        | Description                                            |
+| ------------------ | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
+| `id`               | `String`    | CUID primary key                                       |
+| `userId`           | `String`    | Owner                                                  |
+| `initialized`      | `Boolean`   | Whether the draft has been edited at least once        |
+| `name`             | `String`    | Display name                                           |
+| `pageWidth`        | `Int`       | Canvas width in pixels                                 |
+| `pageHeight`       | `Int`       | Canvas height in pixels                                |
+| `data`             | `Json`      | JSON-serialized `CanvasObject[]` (with `src` stripped) |
+| `thumbnailImageId` | `String?`   | FK to `Image` table for the canvas thumbnail           |
+| `deletedAt`        | `DateTime?` | Soft-delete timestamp                                  |
+| `isSample`         | `Boolean`   | Whether this is a seeded sample canvas                 |
+
+## How It Works
+
+### Loading a Canvas
+
+`loadFromCanvasDraft()` in the Zustand store handles initialization:
+
+1. Parse the `data` JSON string into a `CanvasObject[]`
+2. Batch-fetch image URLs via `/api/images/src?ids=...` for all `ImageObject`s with `imageIds`
+3. Batch-fetch video URLs via `/api/videos/src?ids=...` for all `VideoObject`s with `videoId`
+4. Collect font families from `TextObject`s and load them via `loadFonts()`
+5. Create an initial `HistoryEntry` with action `"Initial Load"` and set `historyIndex` to 0
+6. Set `isLoaded: true` to unblock the UI
+
+On error, the store falls back to an empty canvas with `isLoaded: true` to avoid blocking the UI.
+
+### Two-Stage Editing Pattern
+
+Canvas edits use a two-stage pattern to separate working state from committed state:
+
+- **`tempCanvasObjects`** -- the working copy. Updated via `updateTempCanvasObjects()` during drag, resize, text editing, etc. Frame objects are automatically reordered to the end of the array to maintain z-order.
+- **`canvasObjects`** -- the committed copy. Updated when `commitTempCanvasObjects()` is called, which also pushes a new history entry.
+
+`commitTempCanvasObjects()` uses hash-based deduplication: it computes a string hash of the current `tempCanvasObjects` and compares it against the last history entry. If the hashes match, no new history entry is created. This prevents redundant entries from repeated commits of identical state.
+
+### Auto-Save Mechanism
+
+Auto-save is wired up in `GazaiCanvas`:
+
+```typescript
+// components/canvas/gazai-canvas.tsx
+const { debouncedSave } = useSaveCanvas();
+
+useEffect(() => {
+  if (isReadOnly) return;
+  debouncedSave();
+}, [history, debouncedSave, isReadOnly]);
+```
+
+When `history` changes, `debouncedSave()` is called. The save pipeline in `useSaveCanvas`:
+
+1. Capture a thumbnail from the Konva stage via `stage.toBlob()`
+2. Upload the thumbnail to `/api/canvas/thumbnail`
+3. Read fresh `canvasObjects` from the store (not from the render closure)
+4. Strip transient properties: `src` from images, `src`/`poster`/`isUploading` from videos
+5. Call `updateCanvasDraft()` (or `createCanvasDraft()` for first save)
+6. On success: update `lastSavedAt`, invalidate React Query cache, track via Mixpanel
+
+### Configuration
+
+| Setting        | Value   | Description                                          |
+| -------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
+| Debounce delay | 3000ms  | Wait time after last history change before saving    |
+| Max wait       | 10000ms | Maximum time before a save is forced despite changes |
+| Max history    | 50      | Maximum entries in the undo/redo stack               |
+
+### Server-Side Save Operations
+
+| Action                     | File                       | Description                                         |
+| -------------------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
+| `createCanvasDraft`        | `actions/canvas/canvas.ts` | Create with validated name, data, and thumbnail     |
+| `createMinimalCanvasDraft` | `actions/canvas/canvas.ts` | Create a blank draft (used for new canvas redirect) |
+| `updateCanvasDraft`        | `actions/canvas/canvas.ts` | Full update with ownership check                    |
+| `updateCanvasDraftName`    | `actions/canvas/canvas.ts` | Name-only update                                    |
+| `updatePageSize`           | `actions/canvas/canvas.ts` | Page dimensions update                              |
+| `saveCanvasDraft`          | `actions/canvas/canvas.ts` | Lightweight data-only save                          |
+| `deleteCanvasDraft`        | `actions/canvas/canvas.ts` | Soft delete (sets `deletedAt`)                      |
+| `duplicateCanvasDraft`     | `actions/canvas/canvas.ts` | Deep clone with new IDs and image duplication       |
+
+## Edge Cases & Known Limitations
+
+| Limitation                   | Description                                                                                    |
+| ---------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
+| No client-side persistence   | The Zustand store has no persist middleware -- no localStorage or IndexedDB for the main store |
+| No offline support           | Saves require network connectivity; no queuing or retry for offline edits                      |
+| No real-time collaboration   | Single-user editing only; no multi-user sync                                                   |
+| No multi-tab sync            | Opening the same canvas in two tabs can cause save conflicts                                   |
+| Image URLs are transient     | `src` is stripped on save and re-fetched on load; URLs are signed and expire                   |
+| History is session-only      | Undo/redo stack is lost on page reload                                                         |
+| Data loss on early tab close | If the tab closes before the 3s debounce fires, unsaved changes are lost                       |
+
+## See Also
+
+- [Canvas Overview](_index.md)
+- [Object Types](object-types.md) -- the `CanvasObject` union type that gets persisted
+- [Toolbar Tools](toolbar-tools.md) -- tools that create and modify canvas objects
+- `docs/canvas-object-hierarchy.md` -- detailed technical data model specification
